title: POST /retrieve request
description: Body of POST /retrieve (Content-Type: application/json, at most 16384 bytes). Unknown fields are rejected with 400 invalid_request. The server trims the question before checking it and requires k to be written as a JSON integer (6, not 6.0).

question.description: 1-2000 characters, at least one of them not whitespace; no NUL.

k.description: Maximum number of ranked hits (default 6). Section completion can append more.
